text:
emma_marketing: Drafting a compact follow-up one-pager called 'Assured Vault Brief' for webinar attendees in regulated sectors. Need: single-sheet AE handoff, 3 short ad variants, and simple inbound routing for audit-sensitive leads.

raj_growth: Love the name. For ads let's test two CTAs first 10 days: 'Request audit-ready demo' vs 'Talk to a compliance expert' and track demo-to-oppty rate.

olivia_sales: Handoff checklist: one-pager PDF, 2-line AE opener, 3 objections + counters, and a pricing band. Any lead with tags (gov|health|bank|audit|fedramp) -> enterprise-sdr.

tony_prod: Benchmarks to include (anonymized): "Pilot partner: 6k context, reserved private pod p99 ~105ms; prefix caching lowered token spend ~36%." Add note: hosted shared pools are best-effort with p99 variance ~160-300ms.

mia_ops: Routing rule proposal: keyword scan OR explicit "compliance" checkbox routes to enterprise-sdr. Scoring override: estimated_arr > 110000 -> assign to AE. Will provide webhook and mapping snippet.

faisal_content: I'll write three micro-copy voices: 1) Trust-forward - short, formal; 2) Performance-forward - metric-led; 3) Ops-friendly - cost + predictability. Each headline ~80 chars, one-line subhead.

compliance_bot: Legal note: use 'contractual SLA' language only for Dedicated/Private agreements. For hosted, use 'published targets' or 'indicative latency'. Avoid absolute latency promises for public collateral.

emma_marketing: Add an "elevator benchmark" box template AEs can swap numbers into: "ANON CUSTOMER: 6k context  p99: 105ms (reserved)  Token savings: 36% w/ prefix caching". Keep anonymized.

mia_ops: Webhook example (internal routing):
POST https://hooks.redwood/internal-leads
Content-Type: application/json
Authorization: Bearer <internal-token>
{ "company": "<company>", "contact": "<email>", "tags": ["gov","health"], "estimated_arr": "<num>", "source": "webinar|ad" }

olivia_sales: Also include a tiny config snippet so engineers can see mapping: 
# pseudo-config
rule: match(tags, /gov|health|finserv|audit/i) -> queue enterprise-sdr
priority: estimated_arr > 110000 -> assign AE

faisal_content: Draft micro-copy (headline - subhead):
1) Trust-forward - "Audit-ready deployments, managed your way." - "Private Pods with HSM, KMS integrations, and exportable audit logs for regulated teams."
2) Performance-forward - "Low-latency private inference at scale." - "Reserved pools tuned for consistent sub-150ms p99 on realistic long-context workloads."
3) Ops-friendly - "Predictable pricing for production ML." - "Reserved capacity and caching playbooks to reduce token spend and stabilize monthly costs."

raj_growth: UTMs I'll use: utm_source=webinar, utm_campaign=assured_vault, utm_content={cta_variant}. Also set ad landing for 'audit-demo' to include a form checkbox for compliance needs.

olivia_sales: AE one-liner: 'We provide contractual uptime and availability for Dedicated/Private contracts; hosted is offered with published targets.' Legal ok?

compliance_bot: OK as long as collateral differentiates which tiers are contractual and we remove hard hosted latency figures from public pages.

emma_marketing: Timeline: one-pager draft today, legal check by EOD, routing + webhook test tomorrow AM, paid A/B launch Thursday. Faisal, please upload copy + PDF mock by 4pm and tag @olivia_sales. Anything else?
